question: What if a particular beast is desired?
premises: but if desire is for a particular one
give so many beasts, as Maheshin said
inference: Particular desire is met by particular offering, in stated number.
uncertainties: tavatas (so-many) number left to the cited word
plain_english: But if desire is for that beast in particular, then offer it — give so many beasts, as said by Maheshin.
